proposals.evidence: DEDR990(b) explicitly gives Malayalam okka together/all. These okka all/whole responses match that particular subgroup, which fits the current *okk- parent. proposals.evidence: DEDR2668 gives Tamil cutti/cuttiyal, Malayalam cutti/cuttika, Kannada suttige, Tulu sutti/suttè, Telugu sutte and Gondi sutte hammer. These survey cut-/sut- hammer responses retain the attested family and ordinary suffixes. The article also compares Marathi sutkī; this external comparison is retained as a caveat and does not establish an immediate donor for these forms. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
